main_text.p: propter quæ per Regem Franciæ appellatū est contra eum, ad illum cuius interest: donec, convocato consilio, se à criminibus purgaret obiectis. Circa festum natiuitatis beatæ Virginis, videlicet in vigilia natiuitatis eiusdem, venit summo manè magnus exercitus hominū armatorū missus ex parte Regis Franciæ repēte ad portas ciuitatis Anaguinæ, in quā Papa confugerat pro tutela: quia ibidem natus fuerat. Inueniētes igitur portas apertas ingressi sunt ciuitatē, & mox dederunt insultum Palatio domini Papę. Communitas vero villę cōperto, quòd Willelmus de Longaretto, (legendū est Nogaretto) senescha-lus Regis Frāciæ aduenisset, vt Papā deponeret, vel necaret, statim pulsata cōmuni campana, & tractatu habito, elegerunt sibi capitaneū quēdā Adnulphū, qui quidē illis ignorātibus extitit domini Papæ capitalis inimicus. Hi omnes cōmunibus votis tātū irruerūt in Papā, & nepotē suū, & tres Cardinales (q à tergo p latrinā euaserūt) q; diu (vt putabatur) eis resistere nō valeret. Ob q; cū Dns Papa timēs sibi, treugas petiit. Quib. finitis, exercit⁹ p vim ad papā est ingressus, quē tūc plurimi verbis contumeliosis sunt aggressi. Cū aūt ad rationē posit⁹ esset, an vellet renūtiare Papatui, cōstārer respōdit, Nō: imò citi⁹ vellet pdere caput suū, dicēs in suo vulgari: Ecco il collo: Ecco il capo: q; est dicere, ecce collū, ecce caput. Et statim, ptelstatus est coram omnib⁹, q; Papatui nūq; renūtiaret, quādiu posset habere vitā. exercitus vero postquā irrupit palatiū, mox despoliauit Papā, & eius cameram, atq; thesauria suam,

page.notes: Several words are damaged by the binding and by print; the passage about Nogaretto is printed as shown. Some abbreviations (q;, p, Dns) are kept as printed. Words such as "ptelstatus" and "ptelstatus" are doubtful and may be printing errors.
